The '''Viscera''' was a cutting kit produced by [[SurvivalEquipment Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It contained multiple saws, [[Knife/Legends|knives]] and hooks.<ref name="ETU" />
